result.question: Where did the old prophet bury the body of the man of God?

readings.support: brought it back to his own city to mourn for him and bury him

assessments.reason: 13:30 says, “Then he laid the body in his own tomb,” matching the key exactly.
13:29 mentions bringing the body to his own city, but 13:30 specifies the burial location: “in his own tomb,” not merely the city.

result.reason: The passage explicitly states the burial was in the old prophet’s own tomb, and one reading gives that answer.
